Wow, that bike is so fast!
哇，那辆自行车骑得好快呀！
fat: The fat cat sleeps on my bed.
胖胖的猫睡在我的床上。
Why is the hamster so fat?
这只仓鼠怎么这么胖呀？
Wow, your goldfish is so fat!
father: My father drives me to school.
I love my father very much!
favor: Can you do me a favor?
I do a favor for my friend.
Do me one small favor, please!
favorite: My favorite animal is the panda.
我最喜欢的动物是熊猫。
fawn: A small fawn stands near its mother.
一只小鹿站在妈妈身边。
Did you see the fawn in the forest?
你在森林里看到小鹿了吗？
The baby fawn walks to her mother!
小鹿宝宝朝妈妈走过去呢！
feast: There is a big feast on the table.
桌上摆了满满一大桌好吃的。
Did you like the feast at grandmother's house?
你喜欢奶奶家的大餐吗？
feather: Look, a feather is on your shoe!
看，一根羽毛落在你的鞋上啦！
The little bird has one blue feather.
这只小鸟有一根蓝色的羽毛。
Is this feather from the little owl?
这根羽毛是那只小猫头鹰的吗？
feathers: The parrot has very colorful feathers.
鹦鹉的羽毛五颜六色的。
Are those feathers from the big owl?
那些羽毛是大猫头鹰身上的吗？
Look at all those yellow feathers!
看那么多黄色的羽毛呀！
fed: She fed the ducks at the lake.
Wow, father fed the horse a big carrot!
哇，爸爸喂了马一根大胡萝卜！
feed: Feed the cat at five, please!
We feed the geese bread by the lake.
我们在湖边喂鹅吃面包。
What do you feed your hamster?
feel: My feet feel cold in the snow.
在雪地里我的脚感觉冷冷的。
Come here and feel the warm water!
过来摸摸这暖暖的水呀！
feelings: It is ok to have big feelings.
有很大的情绪也没关系哦。
Do you think toys have feelings, too?
你觉得玩具也有感受吗？
Tell your mother about your feelings!
把你的感受告诉妈妈吧！
feet: The baby elephant has big flat feet.
小象有一双又大又平的脚。
How many feet does a spider have?
Take off your shoes and dry your feet!
把鞋子脱掉，把脚擦干吧！
fell: The cup fell off the table.
Who fell down on the ice?
Oops, the little duck fell in the mud!
哎呀，小鸭子掉进泥巴里啦！
female: The female bird sits on her eggs.
Is that big spider a female?
Wow, the female frog has many eggs!
哇，这只雌青蛙有好多卵呢！
fence: Our cat sits on the red fence.
我们家的猫坐在红色栅栏上。
How tall is the garden fence?
The horse jumps over the high fence!
马儿跳过了高高的栅栏呢！
